bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small bags up to 6" x 9" are allowed. Non-clear backpacks and purses are not.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Clutches up to 6" x 9" (15cm x 23cm), clear or not
Hydration packs with two main compartments and one small one (empty on entry)
prohibited: Non-clear purses and bags larger than 6" x 9"
bagPolicy.note: Hydration packs have no size limit and do not need to be clear. Lockers (about 8" x 12" x 18") can be rented through the festival. All bags are searched at entry and inside. Policy is for the October 16 and 17, 2026 edition at Mana Wynwood.

parking.note: There is no onsite parking at Factory Town. Carpooling or using rideshare services is highly recommended. Be cautious of unauthorized parking operators near the venue.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in III Points's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at III Points varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible routes connect entrances, stages, accessible viewing areas, and vendors across asphalt and grass terrain, but there is no transportation between stages. Visit the Accessibility Services Hub for help finding the most accessible route.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: There is no re-entry, and no ins and outs, on any festival day.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at III Points. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Guests with disabilities and up to one companion can use the accessible entry lane to the left of the entrance, then visit the Accessibility Services Hub straight inside. Service animals must get a service animal credential at the entrance before entering.
